War.Title: War!
War.Text:
War is played out through a simple dice roll by the attacker. Roll on the table below and describe/draw in the results.
With a “Neighboring War” roll, choose any two factions on the map and select one to be the attacker then roll on the chart and draw in the results.

NeighborsDevelop.Title: Neighbors Develop
NeighborsDevelop.Text: Each player will take turns rolling on the appropriate table for every non-prime faction in their home region.  Roll once for each neighbor
